title: Closing Department Standard: The Initial Closing Disclosure and Its Lender Credits on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Standard.** Larkspur issues the initial Closing Disclosure of a Mortgage Loan File that is clear to close as the first Closing Disclosure on the file, sent through the e-sign portal, and fixes on it the total lender credits.

**Dating.** A Closing Disclosure is never dated on a day on which a Loan Estimate was issued on the file: when a Loan Estimate was issued on the file on the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared, the Closing Disclosure is dated and delivered on the next business day, a business day being Monday through Friday excluding the US federal public holidays observed by the Federal Reserve Banks; otherwise it is dated and delivered on the day it is prepared.

**When the lender credits are fixed.** The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the fee ledger carries the application fee collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee. The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are not fixed until every zero-tolerance increase over the good-faith baseline has a cure entry assessed on the file.

## Dating, worked through (hypothetical, no holidays in the period)

| Day the Closing Disclosure is prepared | Loan Estimate issued on the file that day | Dated and delivered on |
|---|---|---|
| Tuesday | no | Tuesday |
| Tuesday | yes | Wednesday |
| Friday | yes | the following Monday |

## Issuing tool: `issue_closing_disclosure_6debf4ff`

**Capability.** Issues the initial Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File with its total lender credits. One call adds the first Closing Disclosure (sequence 1, no changed circumstance) to the file's disclosure history, dated and released to the borrower's e-sign portal on the date given (today, or a later delivery date the disclosure is queued for), carrying the lender credit amount given; its receipt date stays empty until the borrower acknowledges it in the portal. The borrower can then open the Closing Disclosure in the portal.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_closing_disclosure_6debf4ff` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_file_id` | the reference number of the Mortgage Loan File the Closing Disclosure is issued on, as returned by the loan file lookup | identifier |
| `issued_date` | the date the Closing Disclosure is dated and delivered to the e-sign portal | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time, no time zone); today's date or a later delivery date, never empty |
| `lender_credit_amount` | the total lender credits disclosed on the Closing Disclosure, shown as an amount of 0.00 or more | US dollars with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Closing Disclosure <disclosure id> issued on loan file <loan file id>: sequence 1, lender credits <amount> USD, issued <YYYY-MM-DD> via esign_portal.", where the disclosure id is the new disclosure's reference number, the amount has 2 decimals and the date is the `issued_date` passed in. Receiving this line means the Closing Disclosure is on the file with that date.
